questions.question: When the build ends red (tests still failing, or main couldn't be merged in cleanly), should the finisher still come in?

options.label: Only when green (Recommended)
options.description: A red run stays as today: the coordinator stays on, the report says why, nothing is offered for merging. The finisher only appears for a branch that's ready. That way it never ships broken work, and red-run handling doesn't change.

options.label: Always, it explains
options.description: The finisher comes in either way. On red it doesn't offer the steps, just explains what's wrong and waits. One place to finish every run, but it duplicates what the coordinator already reports.
